user.title: Add a fingerprint reader
user.description: Enter ESPHome event prefix (for example esphome.impronte3q).

reconfigure.title: Change ESPHome event prefix
reconfigure.description: Enter the new event prefix (for example esphome.impronte3q). Your stored names and access profiles are preserved. Update ESPHome before changing this value.

error.already_configured: Another reader already uses this event prefix.
error.enrollment_in_progress: Finish or cancel enrollment before changing the event prefix.

actions.title: Configure access profiles
actions.description: Configure the sequences executed for recognized prints. No actions means no unlocking. Variables: finger_id, person_name, profile.

enroll.title: Register fingerprint
enroll.description: Confirm the physical slot is free. Permissions are added only after successful enrollment.

data.name: Name
data.confirm_free_slot: I have checked the slot is free

remove.title: Revoke and delete
remove.description: Authorization will be revoked before deletion from the reader.
